## Motivation

Each chat request validates every tool's JSON schema, a blocking Python check on the API event loop. Agents resend the same tools across turns.

## Modifications

Cache successful schema checks in a per-process LRU of at most 4,096 digests. Invalid schemas are never cached. Existing configs need no change.

Schemas that orjson cannot serialize, or with NaN or Infinity, use the existing path. With this path removed, a server accepted a null `maximum` after a NaN `maximum` over gRPC, because orjson writes NaN as null. Main rejects it.

Deliberate limits:

- Direct Python callers can pass tuples or Enums that digest like their JSON forms. HTTP and gRPC JSON cannot contain them.

These limits are deliberate. Do not add code for them without a real input that reaches the case.

## Accuracy Tests

No accuracy eval ran, because prompts and sampling are unchanged.

At `1efa97ae36` and main `e298298511` on one B200, `/v1/tokenize` token digests for `qwen3_coder.json` and `kimik3.json` matched, as did status codes and error messages (first 170 characters). HTTP chat and gRPC covered valid, invalid, null `maximum`, NaN and 2**70 schemas. HTTP chat covered aliases, reordered keys, nesting and non-objects. `/v1/tokenize` and `/v1/messages` covered valid and invalid.

With a temporary log, 4,400 distinct HTTP schemas plus gRPC traffic held the cache at 4,096 digests on the main thread, and no request failed.

The repeat-schema test fails on main with `3 != 1`. Chat, Anthropic, gRPC and normalization tests found no failures.

GLM-5.3-Flash, gRPC latency, multiple API workers and GitHub test workflows (no `run-ci` label) were not checked.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

This CI model has no cookbook page. Tool sets are generated.

```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct --grpc-port <port> --tool-call-parser llama3 --enable-cache-report --mem-fraction-static 0.3
```

Servers alternated, so TTFT cells have two medians of 30 identical streaming `max_tokens` 1 requests. The saving at one request matches the `check_schema` cost.

| Measurement, ms | Main `f171859219` | This PR on `f171859219` | Main `e298298511` | `1efa97ae36` |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| TTFT, no tools, 44 prompt tokens, `cached_tokens` 0 | 8.5, 8.4 | 8.3, 9.1 | 8.7, 8.5 | 8.7, 8.8 |
| TTFT, 18 tools, 31.8 KB, 10,018 prompt tokens, `cached_tokens` 9,984 | 51.7, 51.4 | 13.7, 13.5 | 53.4, 52.2 | 14.2, 14.3 |
| TTFT, 81 tools, 204.8 KB, 63,037 prompt tokens, `cached_tokens` 62,976 | 286.5, 284.5 | 38.3, 38.6 | 284.4, 284.5 | 39.3, 40.4 |
| TTFT, 18 tools, 8 concurrent requests | 367.1, 348.5 | 41.8, 42.6 | 355.0, 355.0 | 45.4, 43.3 |
| TTFT, 81 tools, 8 concurrent requests | 2149.6, 2165.9 | 165.3, 169.0 | 2138.0, 2185.1 | 171.4, 176.2 |
| First request for 18 tools after a server start (one request each) | 347, 348 | 341, 379 | 352, 1075 | 365, 378 |
| First request for 81 tools after a server start (one request each) | 708, 710 | 701, 719 | 710, 710 | 719, 717 |
| 18 schemas, 27 KB: `check_schema` in main columns, cache hit in PR columns | 37.1 | 0.16 | 37.7 | 0.21 |
| 81 schemas, 184 KB: same | 239 | 0.96 | 248.5 | 0.98 |
| 6 schemas of `qwen3_coder.json`, 1.5 KB: same | 8.9 | 0.02 | 9.1 | 0.02 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 from __future__ import annotations
 
 import copy
+import hashlib
 import json
 import logging
 import time
@@ -151,6 +152,35 @@ class ThinkingMode(str, Enum):
 
 _MEDIA_CONTENT_PART_TYPES = frozenset({"image_url", "video_url", "audio_url"})
 _CHAT_TEMPLATE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE = 128
+_VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS_MAX_SIZE = 4096
+# Digests of tool parameter schemas that passed check_schema.
+_VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS: OrderedDict[bytes, None] = OrderedDict()
+
+
+def _check_tool_schema_once(parameters: Any) -> None:
+    """Run check_schema, and skip it for a schema that already passed.
+
+    An agent sends the same tools on every request. check_schema is pure Python
+    and runs on the event loop of the API server. A schema that fails is not
+    remembered, so it is checked and reported every time.
+    """
+    try:
+        payload = orjson.dumps(parameters, option=orjson.OPT_SORT_KEYS)
+        if b"null" in payload:
+            # orjson writes NaN and Infinity as null. A schema with one of them
+            # must not share a digest with the schema that has a real null.
+            json.dumps(parameters, allow_nan=False)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        Draft202012Validator.check_schema(parameters)
+        return
+    digest = hashlib.blake2b(payload, digest_size=16).digest()
+    if digest in _VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS:
+        _VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS.move_to_end(digest)
+        return
+    Draft202012Validator.check_schema(parameters)
+    _VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS[digest] = None
+    if len(_VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS) > _VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS_MAX_SIZE:
+        _VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS.popitem(last=False)
 
 
 def _incomplete_tool_call_indices(parser) -> set[int]:

-                Draft202012Validator.check_schema(tool.function.parameters)
+                _check_tool_schema_once(tool.function.parameters)

 from http import HTTPStatus
 from typing import Optional
 from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
@@ -1894,6 +1895,84 @@ def test_convert_to_internal_request_flat_output_top_logprobs_default_to_b64(sel
                 self.assertEqual(adapted.return_flat_raw_output_top_logprobs, flat)
                 self.assertEqual(adapted.return_flat_raw_top_logprobs_b64, b64)
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tool_request(parameters):
+        return ChatCompletionRequest(
+            model="x",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi?"}],
+            tools=[
+                {
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {
+                        "name": "lookup",
+                        "description": "Look something up.",
+                        "parameters": parameters,
+                    },
+                }
+            ],
+        )
+
+    def test_validate_request_checks_an_unchanged_tool_schema_once(self):
+        """An agent resends its tools on every request: only a new schema is checked."""
+
+        def parameters(marker):
+            return {
+                "type": "object",
+                "properties": {
+                    "query": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": marker}
+                },
+            }
+
+        marker = uuid.uuid4().hex
+        target = "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat.Draft202012Validator.check_schema"
+        with patch(target) as check_schema:
+            for _ in range(3):
+                request = self._tool_request(parameters(marker))
+                self.assertIsNone(self.chat._validate_request(request))
+            self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 1)
+
+            changed = self._tool_request(parameters(marker + "-changed"))
+            self.assertIsNone(self.chat._validate_request(changed))
+            self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 2)
+
+    def test_validate_request_rejects_an_invalid_tool_schema_every_time(self):
+        errors = []
+        for _ in range(2):
+            request = self._tool_request({"type": "not-a-json-type"})
+            errors.append(self.chat._validate_request(request))
+        self.assertIn("invalid 'parameters' schema", errors[0])
+        self.assertEqual(errors[0], errors[1])
+
+    def test_validate_request_forgets_the_least_recently_used_tool_schema(self):
+        module = "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat"
+
+        def validate(marker):
+            request = self._tool_request({"type": "object", "description": marker})
+            self.assertIsNone(self.chat._validate_request(request))
+
+        with (
+            patch(f"{module}._VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS", OrderedDict()),
+            patch(f"{module}._VALID_TOOL_SCHEMAS_MAX_SIZE", 2),
+            patch(f"{module}.Draft202012Validator.check_schema") as check_schema,
+        ):
+            for marker in ("a", "b", "a", "c"):
+                validate(marker)
+            self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 3)
+            validate("a")  # still remembered: "b" was the least recently used
+            self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 3)
+            validate("b")  # forgotten when "c" arrived
+            self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 4)
+
+    def test_validate_request_checks_a_tool_schema_without_a_digest_every_time(self):
+        """A value that orjson cannot write, or writes as null, is never remembered."""
+        target = "sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_chat.Draft202012Validator.check_schema"
+        for value in (2**70, float("nan"), float("inf")):
+            with self.subTest(value=value), patch(target) as check_schema:
+                for _ in range(2):
+                    request = self._tool_request({"type": "number", "maximum": value})
+                    self.assertIsNone(self.chat._validate_request(request))
+                self.assertEqual(check_schema.call_count, 2)
